entities.summary: Christopher John Flexen is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Doosan Bears of the KBO League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Seattle Mariners, Colorado Rockies, Chicago White Sox, and Chicago Cubs.
